# Sugar Belle (G4 — *Friendship Is Magic*)

Sugar Belle is the **pink unicorn baker from Starlight Glimmer's Our Town**, later **Big McIntosh's sweetheart and wife**. Spot her by her deep-purple curls, turquoise mane ties, magenta eyes, and cherry-topped cupcake cutie mark. Under Starlight's forced equality, she wears an equal-sign mark and bakes dreadful muffins; after recovering her talent, she becomes a skilled baker. [Character history](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sugar_Belle).

**Name and voice.** She introduces herself as **Sugar Belle** in *The Cutie Map – Part 1* (2015), so this is an **in-show name**, not a fan nickname. She has dialogue, voiced in English by **Rebecca Shoichet**. A separately designed **1998 G2 pony** also bears the name, but is not her alter ego. [Debut transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Cutie_Map_-_Part_1) · [Voice cast](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt10084490/fullcredits/) · [G2 namesake](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Sugar_Belle).

**Where to recognize her.** *The Cutie Map* (S5: helps expose Starlight); *To Where and Back Again* (S6); *Hard to Say Anything* (S7: Big Mac and Feather Bangs pursue her); *The Break Up Break Down* (S8: a romantic misunderstanding and Mrs. Cake apprenticeship); *The Big Mac Question* (S9: mutual proposals and their wedding under the apple-and-pear trees); and *The Last Problem* (future family scene). Their son appears in the finale, but **“Big Sugar” was a joking suggestion from supervising director Jim Miller, not an established name**. [Wedding episode](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/The_Big_Mac_Question) · [Miller's Q&A](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2019/10/big-jims-q-on-friendship-is-magic.html).
